analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem reported a 35% year-on-year revenue growth to ₹532 crore for Q1 FY27, despite global supply-side disruptions and elevated raw material prices. The company expanded its NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT and introduced several new complex fertilizer variants to enhance its product mix. Management targets a 30-35% turnover growth for the full year and expects quarterly revenue to exceed ₹500 crore in the remaining quarters of FY27. Krishana Phoschem Limited released its financial results presentation for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, reporting strong operational and financial performance with a 34.58% year-on-year increase in quarterly revenue to ₹532.3 crore and a 53.88% growth in profit after tax to ₹47.06 crore. Management highlighted that expanded capacities at Meghnagar-including NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA-are progressively contributing to results alongside favorable macroeconomic factors such as improving monsoons and supportive government policies like the Nutrient Based Subsidy framework.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a 30% to 35% increase in turnover compared to the previous year.
guidance.quote: we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: Management expects quarterly revenue to exceed ₹500 crore for the rest of the fiscal year.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates a steady increase in the utilization of its recently commissioned NPK capacity.
guidance.quote: The NPK capacity commission during the previous quarter is expected to witness a steady ramp-up in utilization over the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver revenue growth of around 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: Yes, including the import and manufacturing we expect 40% growth should not be a big issue.

guidance.claim: Management expects top-line increase of around Rs. 500 crore from the expanded capacity in FY27.
guidance.quote: So, this year we had around Rs. 2,400 odd crore. So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

demand_outlook.claim: A revival in monsoon activity in early July led to a significant increase in Kharif sowing.
demand_outlook.quote: This pivot has triggered a massive acceleration in Kharif growing across our primary marketing zone.

demand_outlook.claim: Higher Minimum Support Prices for Kharif crops are expected to support fertilizer application rates.
demand_outlook.quote: These revisions will directly strengthen farmgate economics, enhance purchasing power, and support optimal fertilizer application rates.

demand_outlook.claim: Underlying fertilizer demand remains strong despite supply-side constraints.
demand_outlook.quote: This indicates that the decline in production was primarily due to supply-side constraints, including raw material availability and logistic challenges, rather than any weakness in underlying fertilizer demand.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth supported by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and continued government backing through NBS are creating a favourable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: The Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry given comfortable domestic stock levels and favourable monsoons.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: A structural shift toward balanced nutrient application is further strengthening long-term sector prospects.
demand_outlook.quote: A structural shift toward balanced nutrient application is further strengthening long-term sector prospects.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand during the Rabi season for the quarter ended March 2026 remained stable.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable despite a slightly lower monsoon forecast.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added 165,000 MT of NPK-DAP capacity, bringing the total to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is currently assessing potential opportunities for further capacity expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its NPK/DAP capacity to 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid capacity to 99,000 MTPA at Meghnagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: Total fertilizer capacities stand at 6,15,000 MTPA.
The company enhanced its NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Sulphuric acid capacity stands at 99,000 MTPA as part of backward integration.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under India's National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

margins_costs.claim: The company has successfully passed on approximately 25% to 30% of increased input costs to customers.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Sulfur prices experienced a sharp increase, reaching nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the manufacturing segment are approximately 16%.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The introduction of new NPK products contributed to improved EBITDA margins during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The production and sales of these new NPK products during the quarter contributed to the improvement in EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia have led to higher freight and procurement costs.
margins_costs.quote: The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.

margins_costs.claim: Global input costs tightened towards the latter part of the quarter due to supply-side constraints and higher freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per ton on the manufacturing side was in the range of Rs. 5,500 per ton in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved 121% capacity utilization for its SSP unit during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production for the quarter reached 89,747 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: At peak utilization, the current asset base has the potential to generate over ₹3,000 crore in revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: Based on the capacity and the pricing I have mentioned, the total revenue potential can be more than ₹3,000 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production reached 397,263 MT for the full year FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons and manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company collected more than ₹700 crore in receivables during the first quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Regarding collection of Rs. 700 crore. Because last quarter the debtors was around Rs. 300 crore. Collection is more than Rs. 700 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Management highlighted disciplined capital allocation as one of the core pillars of its strategic blueprint.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz have introduced uncertainty into global fertilizer supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The commissioning of new capacity led to a significant increase in finance costs and depreciation.
risks_headwinds.quote: It is largely a function of the sharp rise in finance costs and depreciation following the commissioning of the new capacity.

risks_headwinds.claim: The fertilizer business experiences sequential revenue declines in the first quarter due to seasonality.
risks_headwinds.quote: Historically, the fourth quarter is stronger than the first quarter of the following financial year due to seasonal demand patterns.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover compared to the previous year.
management_commitments.quote: we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to maintain a quarterly turnover run rate exceeding ₹500 crore.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: A third-party green ammonia capacity under agreement is expected to commence operations.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains focused on disciplined execution and long-term value creation through the remainder of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the benefits of the capacity expansion to reflect from FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.claim: The newly commenced expansion capacity is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.
management_commitments.quote: As our Managing Director mentioned, our new expansion has already commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering consistent performance and creating long-term value for our stakeholders.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
